title: 안 찍어도 돼
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays a jazz-influenced progression with seventh chords and subtle vibrato. A sub-bass synth provides low-end weight on the downbeats. The drums consist of a crisp electronic snare with a short decay and a soft, rounded kick drum. Female vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate style with light pitch correction and plate reverb. The arrangement features subtle synth pads that swell during transitions. Tempo is 78 BPM in the key of G Major. The vocal melody uses syncopated phrasing and occasional melismatic flourishes.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar with jazz chords, soft sub-bass]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
오늘도 갤러리 열어 [soft electronic snare enters]
스크롤 내리면
다른 얼굴이 지나 어제의 나야
오늘의 나야
필터를 바꿔 봐 거울 속 눈은 그대로야
첫 번째 셔터를 눌러 소리만 남아

[Pre-Chorus]
[synth pads swell]
원하는 나를 찾는 건 끝없는 게임이야
지쳤어
솔직히 안 찍어도 돼
카메라 내려놔 [kick drum becomes more prominent]
있는 그대로야
충분한 하루가 있어
